k8s-workloads.scope: Compare the Kubernetes Eviction subresource, direct deletion and Deployment rollout with the same ready Pods and strict PDB.
k8s-workloads.observation: The API accepted an eviction while budget remained, then refused under a stricter budget. Direct deletion and controller rollout could reduce or replace replicas. Undo restored three ready replicas in a single-node kind cluster.

ddp-code.scope: Observe uneven input termination, two weighting choices and the optimizer-state boundary with two actual CPU/Gloo ranks.
ddp-code.observation: An unmatched operation timed out. The two join denominators produced different weights. After model broadcast, old SGD momentum still diverged until it was explicitly synchronized.

mcp-protocol.scope: Run native MCP SDK tool list invalidation and an independently checked approval boundary over two stdio sessions.
mcp-protocol.observation: The stale approval wrote to the new default destination. The guarded host refreshed and stopped, the tool rejected the old digest, and explicit approval produced one SQLite row.
